description: This file defines the SugarFolder class, which manages folder operations within the SuiteCRM application, including retrieving, creating, updating, deleting folders, managing subscriptions, and generating email folder queries.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: A class managing folder operations, subscriptions, retrieval, and email query generation within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SugarFolder object with optional user and configuration parameters.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromAllFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from all folders.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from a specific folder.

methods.name: checkEmailExistForFolder
methods.description: Checks if an email exists in a specific folder.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves a bean (email) from one folder to another.

methods.name: copyBean
methods.description: Copies a bean (email) from one folder to another.

methods.name: setFolder
methods.description: Creates a new group folder with specified fields.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves folder subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: setSubscriptions
methods.description: Sets folder subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: insertFolderSubscription
methods.description: Creates a folder subscription entry.

methods.name: getParentIDRecursive
methods.description: Recursively finds parent folder IDs until reaching root.

methods.name: clearSubscriptions
methods.description: Deletes all subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: clearSubscriptionsForFolder
methods.description: Deletes all subscriptions for a specific folder.

methods.name: generateArchiveFolderQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL query to retrieve archived emails.

methods.name: generateSugarsDynamicFolderQuery
methods.description: Generates dynamic folder email queries based on folder type.

methods.name: getListItemsForEmailXML
methods.description: Retrieves list of email items for display in XML format.

methods.name: getDynamicFolderCount
methods.description: Returns item count for dynamic folders, optionally unread only.

methods.name: getCountItems
methods.description: Returns total item count in a folder.

methods.name: getCountUnread
methods.description: Returns count of unread items in a folder.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean with the folder.

methods.name: retrieveFoldersForProcessing
methods.description: Builds a collection of user/group folders, including subscription info.

methods.name: getGroupFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares folder list for user settings interface.

methods.name: getFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares folder data including selection states for user settings.

methods.name: removeDeletedFolders
methods.description: Filters out invalid or deleted inbound email folders.

methods.name: getFoldersChildForSettings
methods.description: Recursively retrieves child folders for user settings.

methods.name: getCountNewItems
methods.description: Returns count of new/unread items in a folder based on criteria.

methods.name: getUserFolders
methods.description: Builds and sorts the folder tree for a user, optionally for refresh.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeRefresh
methods.description: Constructs a folder node metadata for refresh purposes.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeFolders
methods.description: Builds a tree node for a folder, including child folders.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Flags a folder as deleted (soft delete).

methods.name: deleteChildrenCascade
methods.description: Recursively deletes folder and its children, with checks.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves folder info, creating or updating database records.

methods.name: addSubscriptionsToGroupFolder
methods.description: Adds default subscriptions to a group folder.

methods.name: createSubscriptionForUser
methods.description: Adds a subscription record for a user.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates folder's properties and hierarchy.

methods.name: findAllChildren
methods.description: Collects all child folder IDs recursively.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Populates folder object properties from database.

methods.name: getFirstDisplayFolders
methods.description: Returns the first folder marked for display.

methods.name: isToDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a folder should be displayed based on subscriptions and settings.

methods.name: shouldFolderDisplay
methods.description: Helper to determine if folder matches display criteria.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleInboundIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of inbound email accounts accessible to user.
